Title: Senior Scientist –Bioassays Function: Method Development, Tech Ops Reports to: Associate Director, Method Development Role Purpose: The Senior Scientist responsible for the design, development, qualification, and lifecycle management of binding, enzymatic, and cell‑based assays supporting biologics and advanced therapies across discovery, development, and commercial stages. This role provides deep technical expertise for complex bioassays, ensuring methods are fit-for-purpose, phase-appropriate and robust, while mentoring scientists and influencing cross‑functional CMC strategy. Key Responsibilities: Scientific & Technical Leadership:
• Lead the development and optimization of binding assays (e.g., ELISA, SPR/BLI), enzymatic assays, and cell‑based bioassays for potency, MoA, and characterization.
• Define assay strategy aligned to MoA, CQAs, and clinical phase, including selection of reference materials, controls, and acceptance criteria.
• Resolve complex assay challenges, including variability, matrix effects, specificity, drift, and biological relevance.
• Drive assay robustness, mechanistic understanding, and biological relevance, particularly for potency and functional assays. Method Validation & Lifecycle Management:
• Author and approve Analytical Target Profiles (ATP), Method Development reports and Pre-qualification reports in alignment with ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14, USP, and EP expectations.
• Ensure methods are phase‑appropriate and support comparability, tech transfer, and post‑approval changes.
• Provide scientific oversight for method troubleshooting, OOS/OOT investigations Technology & Innovation:
• Evaluate and implement new assay technologies and platforms (e.g., automation, digital data capture, novel readouts).
• Champion continuous improvement in assay throughput, reproducibility, and data integrity.
• Partner with automation, data, and IT teams to modernize bioassay workflows. Required Qualifications & Experience:
• PhD in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Immunology, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
• Industry experience developing binding, enzymatic, and/or cell‑based assays for biologics.
• Demonstrated expertise in potency assay development and MoA‑linked bioassays.
• Strong working knowledge of ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14, and regulatory expectations for bioassays.
• Proven experience supporting regulatory submissions and inspections.
• Track record of scientific leadership, mentoring, and cross‑functional influence. About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. It ensures the highest standards of clinical safety while managing advanced research analyses, information systems, and technical documentation. The position also supports laboratory activities and helps maintain regulatory approvals by collaborating closely with health authorities. Additionally, it provides expert scientific guidance, implements specialized technical capabilities, and contributes to rigorous experiment planning, execution, and reporting. The role further supports the growth of the R&D organization by training team members in key scientific and technological platforms. Key Responsibilities:
• Leads the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced technical capabilities, guiding cross-functional teams to achieve complex research objectives within defined timelines
• Oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of high-impact scientific experiments, ensuring the highest standards of scientific rigor and integrity
• Mentors and develops scientific staff, fostering technical growth and knowledge transfer across the organization
• Serves as a recognized authority in the field, contributing to scientific strategy, portfolio planning, and external collaborations
• Manages large-scale, cross-functional projects or programs with minimal oversight, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory expectations
• Solves complex, multi-dimensional problems requiring deep technical insight and cross-disciplinary collaboration
• Represents the organization in scientific forums, publications, and external partnerships, enhancing visibility and thought leadership Your skills and experience
• PhD in a scientific discipline
• Typically, 5–8 years of related experience
• Track record of scientific achievement in relevant Life Sciences discipline
• Mastery of advanced methodologies
• Oversight of research cross-functional teams and initiatives
• Setting direction for scientific programs
• Excellent communication skills (English language). About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ . Our Benefits For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL . You Belong at CSL At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the

Descrizione Responsabile di Senior EHS Expert – Risk Management & Technical Safety (f/m/d) Sviluppano, implementano e migliorano continuamente una gestione sistematica del rischio EHS conforme a ISO‐45001 presso il sito di Berna. Il ruolo comprende la moderazione e l'attuazione di analisi dei rischi, valutazioni dei rischi, indagini pSIF, valutazioni di sicurezza tecnica e l'intensa supervisione EHS di progetti di costruzione, impianti e processi. Inoltre, il ruolo delle coordinate specialistiche EHS: all'interno di progetti e funge da hub tecnico tra ingegneria, operazioni, qualità e EHS. Questa posizione è rivolta a esperti di EHS senior esperti con 8–10 anni di esperienza professionale, forte know-how tecnico, esperienza di gestione del rischio e ottime competenze di comunicazione e moderazione. Principali compiti e responsabilità Gestione del rischio e analisi dei rischi - Moderazione e attuazione di analisi dei rischi e valutazioni dei rischi - (compresi HAZOP, JSA, Bow‐Tie, FMEA, Task-Risk-Valutazioni) - Stabilimento, manutenzione e coordinamento del registro di rischio di localizzazione - Sviluppo delle strategie di mitigazione del rischio per processi, impianti, infrastrutture e attività - Garantire metodi coerenti secondo le norme tecniche ISO 45001 e CSL Investigazione e prevenzione degli incidenti - Responsabile delle indagini pSIF e delle analisi delle cause radice (ICAM, TapRoot, RCA) - Definizione e monitoraggio delle misure di prevenzione sostenibile - Lezioni Imparare e Trasferirsi a Standard, SOP e Formazione Progetti di ingegneria - EHS-Providing costruzione, modernizzazione e progetti di impianti - Partecipazione a Recensioni di progettazione, Controlli di cambiamento, HAZOP, PSSR e diminuzioni tecniche - Assicurare il rispetto degli standard CSL-Technical globali - (ad esempio LOTO, Sicurezza delle macchine e delle piante, Gestione chimica, Permit-to-Work) - Coordinamento tecnico degli specialisti EHS: nell'ambiente di progetto Sistema di conformità e gestione - Garantire il rispetto della norma ISO 45001, della legislazione svizzera e degli standard interni CSL - Cura e sviluppo di processi, documentazione e istruzioni di lavoro - Supporto per audit, certificazioni, contatti governativi Coaching, Stakeholder Management & Comunicazione - Consulenza e coaching dei dirigenti e dei team in materia di rischi, standard e sicurezza - Tradurre rischi tecnici complessi in raccomandazioni chiare e comprensibili per l'azione - Promuovere la cultura EHS sostenibile in tutte le aree
• Requisiti e qualifiche Esperienza - 8-10 anni di esperienza professionale nel campo dell'EHS, della sicurezza tecnica o dell'ingegneria del rischio - ideale nell'industria regolamentata (Pharma, Chimica, Biotech, Energia, Ingegneria Meccanica) - Esperienza rilevativa nella moderazione di analisi sistematiche del rischio - Pratica testata in Incident Investigations & Root-Cause Methods - Esperienza nel supporto di progetti tecnici (costruzione, installazioni, processi) Qualificazione - Studi in ingegneria della sicurezza, ingegneria, chimica, ambiente o disciplina tecnica comparabile - Conoscenze finanziate in ISO 45001, norme di sicurezza tecnica e metodi di rischio - Esperienza nella gestione di materiali pericolosi, sistemi tecnici e sicurezza dei processi Leadership & Soft Skills - Forte capacità di comunicazione e moderazione - Capacità di guidare specialisti e team di progetto professionalmente - Funzionamento attivo, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione - Aspetto sicuro a tutti i livelli gerarchici Lingue - Tedesco: assicurazione - Inglese: molto buono Ti senti indirizzato? Descrizione Responsible as Senior EHS Expert – Risk Management & Technical Safety (f/m/d) They develop, implement and continuously improve a systematic, ISO‐45001-compliant EHS risk management at the Bern site. The role includes the moderation and implementation of risk analyses, risk assessments, pSIF investigations, technical safety assessments as well as the intensive EHS supervision of construction, plant and process projects. In addition, the role of the EHS specialist coordinates: inside projects and acts as a technical hub between engineering, operations, quality and EHS. This position is aimed at experienced senior EHS experts with 8–10 years of professional experience, strong technical know-how, risk management expertise and very good communication and moderation expertise. Main tasks and responsibilities Risk Management & Hazard Analysis - Moderation and implementation of risk analyses and risk assessments - (including HAZOP, JSA, Bow‐Tie, FMEA, Task-Risk-Assessments) - Establishment, maintenance and coordination of the location-wide risk register - Development of Risk Mitigation Strategies for Processes, Plants, Infrastructure and Activities - Ensuring consistent methods according to ISO 45001 and CSL Technical Standards Incident Investigation & Prevention - Head of pSIF investigations and root cause analyses (ICAM, TapRoot, RCA) - Definition and monitoring of sustainable prevention measures - Lessons Learned and Transfer to Standards, SOPs and Training Engineering projects - EHS-Providing construction, modernization and plant projects - Participation in Design Reviews, Change Controls, HAZOPs, PSSR and technical decreases - Ensure compliance with global CSL-Technical Standards - (e.g. LOTO, Machine and Plant Safety, Chemical Management, Permit-to-Work) - Technical coordination of the EHS specialists:inside the project environment Compliance & Management System - Ensuring compliance with ISO 45001, relevant Swiss legislation and internal CSL standards - Care and development of processes, documentation and work instructions - Support for audits, certifications, government contacts Coaching, Stakeholder Management & Communication - Advice and coaching of executives and teams in dealing with risks, standards and security - Translating complex technical risks into clear, understandable recommendations for action - Promoting sustainable EHS culture in all areas
• Requirements & qualifications Experience - 8–10 years of professional experience in the field of EHS, Technical Safety or Risk Engineering - ideal in regulated industry (Pharma, Chemistry, Biotech, Energy, Mechanical Engineering) - Detectional experience in the moderation of systematic risk analyses - Tested practice in Incident Investigations & Root-Cause Methods - Experience in supporting technical projects (construction, installations, processes) Qualification - Studies in safety engineering, engineering, chemistry, environment or comparable technical discipline - Funded knowledge in ISO 45001, technical safety standards and risk methods - Experience in handling hazardous materials, technical systems and process safety Leadership & Soft Skills - Strong communication and moderation capabilities - Ability to guide specialists and project teams professionally - Proactive, structured and solution-oriented operation - Secure appearance at all hierarchical levels Languages - German: insurance - English: very good Do you feel addressed? Then we look forward to your online application. Your application should include a letter of motivation, a CV/CV as well as work certificates and copies of diplomas in the original language and/or relevant transcripts. Please add your files, including CV, to a document. About CSL Behring CSL Beh

Position Purpose The Senior Quality Associate is responsible for managing deviations, investigations, CAPAs, product technical complaints and change controls associated with development activities and manufacture of Investigational Medicinal Product within CSL Clinical Development portfolio. To do this, the GMP Site Quality Associate has the primary purpose of ensuring compliance with GMP/GSP/GxP by providing front‑line quality guidance and support across all phases of Technical Product Development. You will also ensure self‑inspections are conducted and followed up in a timely manner and provide quality and compliance support throughout all aspects of technical product. Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Participate in IPT Project and associate delivery team meetings, providing quality/compliance leadership, guidance and advice
• Manage deviations and OOS investigations and facilitate/attend Deviation Review Board meetings as required
• Manage and facilitate the deviation meeting process, manage deviations to closure, including significant and complex deviations, to ensure that information recorded is comprehensive and remedial actions are appropriate and executed in a timely manner
• Facilitate change panel meetings, manage change controls to completion, including significant and complex changes, to ensure changes are appropriate and comply with regulatory requirements
• Liaison with Technical departments for quality assurance and compliance related issues
• Manage Product Technical Complaints and associated investigations
• Review and approve Technical Document Change Requests
• Conduct self‑inspections, provide reports in a timely manner, assess responses and provide quality advice to maintain regulatory compliance and continuous improvement
• Provide training in QMS principles as required
• Participate in updating of QA documents as relevant to Technical Development
• Provide QA compliance review and approval of relevant product documents
• Attend and manage Quality Risk Assessments (QRAs) as required
• Educate technical staff in GxP and quality system requirements
• Establish and maintain local and global product‑related Quality Agreements
• Position Qualifications and Experience Requirements Education A degree in a relevant biological science, with at least 3 years’ experience in at least one of the following areas:
• Manufacturing under GMP
• Regulatory Affairs
• Quality Assurance
• Relevant Process Development Essential Skills, Knowledge and Attributes
• In‑depth understanding of GMP requirements in the pharmaceutical industry and previous Production, Quality or R&D experience within the pharmaceutical industry
• Sound knowledge of processes for Clinical Trial GMP manufacture
• Understanding of the product development process and environment is desirable

• Ability to relate to and communicate with people of different technical skill backgrounds and at different levels from management to operations within CSL
• Good analytical and problem‑solving skills

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Laurea post-laurea (preferibilmente PhD) in scienze biologiche, biofisica o chimica analitica. Esperienza

He/she will partner with other scientists and external partners to develop fit-for-purpose analytical assays, suggest workflows and provide technical support and training to enable critical process decision-making and support continuous drug development activities. In this position, a high level of knowledge of biophysical techniques is essential to deliver phase appropriate analytical assays and to support enhanced product characterization. The Senior Scientist will contribute to translate innovative platforms and new technologies into fully developed, possibly automated methods. Scientific enthusiasm, creativity, hands-on lab experience and commitment will be essential for the successful achievement of team and organizational goals and timelines. • Responsible for designing and performing experiments as well as for interpreting results from biophysical and chromatography-based techniques to support characterization of new plasma-derived product and commercialized product.
• Development and implementation of novel analytical methods according to analytic quality by design principles and phase-appropriate qualification according to project and product demands.
• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for biophysical and chromatography related topics to provide scientific input to multiple projects and for the implementation of new technologies.

• Experience in the development of analytical methodologies for qualitative and quantitative characterization of proteins using different biophysical and chromatographic techniques.
• In-depth theoretical and extensive hands-on experience on diverse biophysical techniques (e.g. SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) for analysis of protein structure and conformation.
• Knowledge of sub-visible particles characterization using technologies such as Flow Microscopy, DLS, Nano Tracking Analysis is preferred.

The Opportunity Researches and develops innovative medicines to address unmet medical needs, from early discovery through clinical trials to commercialization. It ensures that all products meet the highest clinical safety standards and comply with global regulatory requirements. The role involves analyzing complex data, managing research processes, and maintaining technical documentation and systems. It also includes designing and implementing experimental and operational processes to support efficient product development and informed decision-making. In addition, the position leads projects and cross-functional teams, overseeing portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, and risk management. Finally, it contributes to the development and optimization of manufacturing processes to enable efficient, scalable, and compliant production. Key Responsibilities:
• Provides high quality scientific expertise in applying technology platforms to R&D
• Contributes to the planning, performance, evaluation and reporting of scientific experiments
• Coaches junior scientists and contributes to team development
• Manages projects/processes with limited supervision and ensures scientific rigor
• Collaborates cross-functionally to meet project milestones

• PhD preferred or Master’s degree in a relevant field

Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. descriptionByLocale.en:
You will be accountable for the design and execution of the clinical strategy to support the development of a medicine, aligned with the Project Strategy Document (PSD) and the Target Product Profile (TPP). You are also accountable for the strategic leadership of the Clinical Development Team (CDT) in a matrix environment and is responsible for:
• the timely development and execution of the Clinical Development Plan (CDP).
• managing the day-to-day operations of the CDT including but not limited to meeting coordination and documentation, decision making, and stakeholder management.
• ensuring that the program is conducted in alignment with CSL Behring processes and abiding by GCP and ICH regulations. This position is accountable for the clinical & scientific oversight of the assigned program(s) and:
• ensures high quality clinical & scientific standards are met during all aspects of the program
• providing clinical oversight and expertise during development of clinical studies
• serves as medical monitor for assigned clinical trials or provides oversight to an assigned medical monitor
• serves as the Clinical Development representative on the required cross-functional Delivery Teams (DT) This position is a “Lead Author” or “Contributing Author” for:
• key study documents, including but not limited to the Clinical Development Plan (CDP), the Project Strategy Document (PSD), Investigator Brochures (IB), Clinical Study Protocols (CSP), Informed Consent Forms (ICF), Medical Monitoring Plans (MMP), Clinical Study Reports (CSR).
• the clinical sections of relevant regulatory packages (e.g. IND, NDA, annual reports) and support regulatory RFIs as needed.
• the development of abstracts, presentations, and manuscripts as appropriate. Main Responsibilities: 1 Clinical Development Team (CDT) Leadership:
• Leads the integration of internal and external expert contributions to strategy and design of the assigned clinical program(s).
• Responsible for maintaining alignment across critical stakeholders prior to key decision making forums (e.g. Strategic and Technical Review Committee (STRC) for study outline approval.
• Ensures that the program is conducted in alignment with CSL Behring processes and abiding by GCP and ICH regulations.
• Responsible for driving and documenting decision making within the CDT, facilitating issue resolution and escalation, as well as contingency planning. 2 Clinical & Scientific Oversight:
• Accountable for the clinical content for all CDT deliverables to ensure safe, efficient, and timely execution of assigned clinical programs.
• Ensures high quality clinical and scientific standards are met throughout all aspects of the program.
• Serves as the clinical development representative on the required cross-functional Delivery Teams (DT) including but not limited to the Safety Management Team (SMT), the Benefit-Risk Assessment Team (BRAT), the Biomarker Expert Team (BET), and the Evidence and Access Strategy Team (EAST) for assigned programs.
• Develops and executes the Medical Monitoring Plan (MMP) strategy. Typically serves as the medical monitor for clinical trials during study conduct or provides oversight to assigned medical monitors.
• Presents results to Safety Monitoring Committee and other internal and external meetings. 3 Document Authorship:
• Reviews the data generated during the planning and execution of a study to gather a clinical understanding of the safety and efficacy results and the impact of the data on ongoing R&D strategies and provides support in defining the development strategy.
• Leads preparations of clinical sections of relevant regulatory interaction packages including but not limited to briefing books, INDs, NDAs. BLAs, ODDs, RFIs, and routine reporting.
• Contributing author the publication strategy. Author or contributing author for abstracts, presentations, and manuscripts as appropriate. Qualifications and Experience Requirements:
• MD - Board Certifie

IND, NDA, Jahresberichte) und Unterstützung regulatorischer RFIs bei Bedarf. - die Entwicklung von Abstracts, Präsentationen und Handschriften. Mansion 1 Klinisches Entwicklungsteam (CDT) Leitung: - Führen Sie die Integration von internen und externen Expertenbeiträgen zur Strategie und Gestaltung der zugeordneten klinischen Programme. - Verantwortlich für die Aufrechterhaltung der Ausrichtung auf kritische Interessenträger vor Schlüsselentscheidungsforen (z.B. Strategischer und technischer Prüfungsausschuss (STRC) zur Studienumrissbewilligung. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass das Programm im Einklang mit CSL-Behring-Prozessen und Abiding durch GCP- und ICH-Verordnungen durchgeführt wird. - Verantwortlich für die treibende und dokumentierende Entscheidungsfindung innerhalb der CDT, Erleichterung der Problemauflösung und Eskalation sowie der Notfallplanung. 2 Klinische und wissenschaftliche Aufsicht: - Buchbar für die klinischen Inhalte für alle CDT-Lieferanten, um eine sichere, effiziente und rechtzeitige Durchführung von zugeordneten klinischen Programmen zu gewährleisten. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass hochqualitative klinische und wissenschaftliche Standards in allen Aspekten des Programms erfüllt sind. - Serviert als klinische Entwicklungsrepräsentant für die erforderlichen funktionsübergreifenden Lieferteams (DT), einschließlich aber nicht beschränkt auf das Safety Management Team (SMT), das Benefit-Risk Assessment Team (BRAT), das Biomarker Expert Team (BET) und das Evidence and Access Strategy Team (EAST) für zugewiesene Programme. - Entwickelt und führt die Strategie Medical Monitoring Plan (MMP) aus. Typischerweise dient als medizinischer Monitor für klinische Studien während des Studiengangs oder bietet Aufsicht auf zugeordnete medizinische Monitore. - Gibt Ergebnisse für den Sicherheitsüberwachungsausschuss und andere interne und externe Treffen vor. 3 Dokument Autor: - prüft die bei der Planung und Durchführung einer Studie erzeugten Daten, um ein klinisches Verständnis der Sicherheits- und Wirksamkeitsergebnisse und die Auswirkungen der Daten auf laufende FuE-Strategien zu sammeln und unterstützt die Entwicklungsstrategie. - Leads Vorbereitungen von klinischen Abschnitten relevanter regulatorischer Interaktionspakete, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Briefing Bücher, INDs, NDAs. BLAs, ODDs, RFIs und Routineberichte. - Autorin die Publikationsstrategie. Autor oder Beitragsautor für Abstracts, Präsentationen und Handschriften. Voraussetzungen - MD - Board Certifie

Descrizione Vous serez responsable de la conception et de l'exécution de la stratégie clinique pour appuyer l'élaboration d'un médicament, conformément au Document de stratégie du projet (DSP) et au Profil du produit cible (PPT). Vous êtes également responsable du leadership stratégique de l'équipe de développement clinique (ECC) dans un environnement matriciel et vous êtes responsable : - l'élaboration et l'exécution opportunes du Plan de développement clinique (PDC). - gérer les activités quotidiennes du CDT, y compris, sans s'y limiter, la coordination et la documentation des réunions, la prise de décisions et la gestion des intervenants. - s'assurer que le programme est mené en conformité avec les processus de consanguinité de la LSC et qu'il est conforme aux règlements du GCP et de l'ICH. Ce poste est responsable de la surveillance clinique et scientifique du ou des programmes assignés et : - s'assure que les normes cliniques et scientifiques de haute qualité sont respectées pendant tous les aspects du programme - fournir une surveillance clinique et une expertise pendant le développement des études cliniques - sert de moniteur médical pour les essais cliniques assignés ou assure la surveillance d'un moniteur médical assigné - est le représentant du développement clinique des équipes de prestation interfonctionnelles (DT) Cette position est un Auteur Lead ou Auteur Contribuant pour: - les principaux documents d'étude, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le Plan de développement clinique (PDC), le Document de stratégie du projet (DSP), les Brochures des chercheurs (IB), les Protocoles d'étude clinique (PSC), les Formulaires de consentement éclairé (FIC), les Plans de surveillance médicale (PMM), les Rapports d'étude clinique (REC). - les sections cliniques des trousses réglementaires pertinentes (p. ex. IND, NDA, rapports annuels) et appuyer les DDR réglementaires au besoin. - l'élaboration de résumés, de présentations et de manuscrits selon les besoins. Mansioni 1 Leadership de l'équipe de développement clinique (ECC) : - Dirige l'intégration des contributions internes et externes d'experts à la stratégie et à la conception des programmes cliniques assignés. - Responsable du maintien de l'alignement entre les intervenants essentiels avant les forums de prise de décisions clés (p. ex. Comité d'examen stratégique et technique (CRST) pour approbation du plan d'étude. - S'assure que le programme est mené en conformité avec les processus CSL Behring et qu'il est conforme aux règlements GCP et ICH. - Responsable de la conduite et de la documentation de la prise de décisions au sein du CDT, facilitant la résolution des problèmes et l'escalade, ainsi que la planification d'urgence. 2 Surveillance clinique et scientifique : - Rendre compte du contenu clinique de tous les produits livrables des CDT afin d'assurer l'exécution sécuritaire, efficace et en temps opportun des programmes cliniques assignés. - S'assurer que les normes cliniques et scientifiques de haute qualité sont respectées dans tous les aspects du programme. - Assure le rôle de représentant du développement clinique dans les équipes de prestation interfonctionnelles requises, y compris, sans s'y limiter, l'équipe de gestion de la sécurité (EMS), l'équipe d'évaluation des risques et des avantages (EAR), l'équipe d'experts en biomarqueurs (EAR) et l'équipe de stratégie sur les preuves et l'accès (EAR) pour les programmes assignés. - Élaborer et exécuter la stratégie du Plan de surveillance médicale. Habituellement, il sert de moniteur médical pour les essais cliniques au cours de l'étude ou assure la surveillance des moniteurs médicaux affectés. - Présente les résultats au Comité de surveillance de la sécurité et à d'autres réunions internes et externes. 3 Auteur du document : - Examiner les données générées au cours de la planification et de l'exécution d'une étude afin de recueillir une compréhension clinique des résultats en matière d'innocuité et d'efficacité ainsi que de l'incidence des données sur les stratégies de R-D en cours et aider à définir la stratégie de développement. - Dirige la préparation des sections cliniques des trousses d'interaction réglementaire pertinentes, y compris, sans s'y limiter, les cahiers d'information, les IND et les ADN. BLA, ODD, DDR et rapports de routine. - Contribuer à la stratégie de publication. Auteur ou auteur contributeur pour les résumés, les présentations et les manuscrits selon le cas.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to standards related to infrastructure, processes, and scientific consulting. Job Qualifications and Experience Requirements Education

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per la nostra Ingegneria e Manutenzione, stiamo cercando un Capo di Servizi Integrati di Facility & Operations

Il Capo dei Servizi Integrati di Facility & Operations è un leader senior responsabile della supervisione strategica e tattica della funzione di compliance engineering, della struttura e dei servizi integrati incl. pianificazione dell'occupazione, controllo del cambiamento, gestione della formazione, gestione dei documenti, nonché dati e supporto più gestione e pianificazione MRO. Questo ruolo garantisce l'adesione agli standard di sicurezza, qualità, conformità e eccellenza operativa a sostegno delle operazioni di produzione. L'incumbent promuove il miglioramento continuo, la conformità normativa e l'efficace allocazione delle risorse, promuovendo al contempo una cultura dell'innovazione e della collaborazione.

Oggetto del lavoro

• Sviluppare ed eseguire una strategia di struttura completa allineata agli obiettivi aziendali e alle best practice globali

• Sostenere l'esecuzione dei portafogli dei progetti di capitale, compresi i servizi, le utility e la manutenzione ingegneristica, assicurando che i progetti vengano consegnati in tempo, entro il budget e per gli standard di qualità

• Sviluppare e implementare politiche e procedure per garantire il rispetto continuo del prodotto e delle operazioni alle attuali norme di qualità, sicurezza e regolamentazione (FDA, EMA, ISO, ecc.)

• supervisionare i programmi per i fornitori di servizi integrati e gestire i fornitori chiave per le utenze del sito (Freezer/HVAC, acqua, caldaia, sistemi HEPA, sistemi PSM) e storeroom/MRO

• Sviluppare, monitorare e segnalare i KPI e i processi per garantire la gestione di pietre miliari, obblighi contrattuali, requisiti di conformità e passività di pietra miliare

• supervisionare i servizi di progettazione e CAD

• Progettazione dell'occupazione del sito di piombo e gestione dello spazio

• Costruire, influenzare e gestire relazioni e consegnabili con fornitori di servizi integrati, stakeholder interni e collaborare con i leader per evitare e mitigare i problemi

• Iniziative di miglioramento del processo

• Promuovere una cultura del miglioramento continuo attraverso la selezione dei dipendenti, la formazione e il mentoring

• Previsione, sviluppo, traccia e revisione del progetto di ristrutturazione/manutenzione del capitale

• Identificare opportunità di progettazione, costruzione e miglioramento dei costi operativi

• Supera i centri di costo assegnati, monitora le prestazioni, agisce sulle tendenze e garantisce l'adesione ai budget più sviluppare budget per OpEx e headcount

• Assicura la conformità finanziaria (cioè SOx) nell'ambito della responsabilità

• Implement CSL Operating System, Six Sigma, Lean e altre metodologie di miglioramento continuo / guidare l'adozione di nuove tecnologie e/o servizi

• Piombo, mentore e sviluppare un team di ingegneri, professionisti della manutenzione e specialisti di qualità diversificati

Le tue abilità ed esperienza

• Deve essere un diffusore tedesco fluente

• BS/BA in Ingegneria o Scienza necessaria; MS/MBA ha preferito

• 10+ anni di esperienza manageriale in ingegneria, manutenzione, IFM, impianti e ingegneria di conformità all'interno della produzione (biopharma altamente preferito)

• Competenze significative e dimostrate nell'ingegneria di conformità GMP/non-GMP, nella gestione dei dati degli asset e nei servizi integrati relativi alla produzione farmaceutica

• Gestione di grandi progetti multifunzionali

• Esperienza nella conformità normativa e nell'eccellenza operativa in un ambiente biofarmaceutico globale

For our Engineering & Maintenance, we are looking for a Head of Integrated Facility & Operations Services

The Head of Integrated Facility & Operations Services is a senior leader accountable for the strategic and tactical oversight of the compliance engineering function, facility and integrated services incl. occupancy planning, change control, training management, document management, as well as data and support plus MRO management and planning. This role ensures adherence to industry standards of safety, quality, compliance, and operational excellence in support of manufacturing operations. The incumbent drives continuous improvement, regulatory compliance, and effective resource allocation, while fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration.

Job Purpose

• Develop and execute a comprehensive facility strategy aligned with business objectives and global best practices

• Support the execution of capital project portfolios, including facilities, utilities, and engineering maintenance, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to quality standards

• Create, maintain and execute on a multi-year site facility strategy, including scope and budget for capital projects

• Ensure departments operate in compliance with cGMP, including equipment/facility upkeep

• Develop and implement policies and procedures to assure continual compliance with product and operations to current quality, safety, and regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, ISO, etc.)

• Oversee programs for integrated service providers and manage key vendors for site utilities (Freezer/HVAC, water, boiler, HEPA, PSM systems) and storeroom/MRO systems

• Develop, monitor and report on KPIs and processes to ensure financial milestones, contractual obligations, compliance requirements, and milestone liabilities are managed

• Oversee engineering drafting and CAD services

• Lead site occupancy planning and space management

• Build, influence, and manage relationships and deliverables with integrated service providers, internal stakeholders and collaborate with leaders to avoid and mitigate problems

• Drive process improvement initiatives

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement through employee selection, training and mentoring

• Forecast, develop, track, and review facility renovation/maintenance capital project budgets

• Identify opportunities for design, construction, and operating cost improvements

• Oversees assigned cost centers, monitors performances, acts on trends and ensures adherence to budgets plus develop budgets for OpEx and headcounts

• Ensures financial compliance (i.e. SOx) within area of responsibility

• Implement CSL Operating System, Six Sigma, Lean, and other continuous improvement methodologies / drive the adoption of new technologies and/or services

• Lead, mentor, and develop a diverse, cross-functional team of engineers, maintenance professionals, and quality specialists on site

Your Skills and Experience

• Must be a fluent German speaker

• BS/BA in Engineering or Science required; MS/MBA preferred

• 10+ years managerial experience in engineering, maintenance, IFM, facilities, and compliance engineering within manufacturing (biopharma highly preferred)

• Significant and demonstrated expertise in GMP/non-GMP compliance engineering, asset data management and integrated facilities services related to pharmaceutical production

• Experience managing large multifunctional projects

• Track record of several years successful inspection and audit exposure

• Experience with regulatory compliance and operational excellence in a global biopharma environment

• Knowledge of Six Sigma/Lean principles is a plus

• Proficiency in selected IT systems (e.g. Trackwise, SAP, FMS, Ariba, DCMS, Veeva, (LMS) Plateau) preferred

Job Description: The engineering Associate Director of Sustaining Engineering is a new role within CSL’s Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP). This role will provide technical leadership to support marketed combination products. The individual will work with DDSP and peer departments, e.g., Quality Assurance, to implement changes and improvements to combination products to ensure safety and reliability. Changes may include process optimization, CDMO evaluation, tech transfers, supplier-related changes, and risk management updates. This role will also identify and leverage best practices supporting the needs of a diverse combination product portfolio as well as formalizing and standardizing approaches. This role serves as a key interface between DDSP, project teams, External Organizations, Commercial, and corporate initiatives for scoping and vetting design improvement projects. Responsibilities:
• The role ensures all sustaining activities are conducted in compliance with applicable standards and regulations including ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 4, QMSR, and 211, and relevant ICH guidelines.
• Partner with manufacturing, CDMOs, and quality to drive design improvements, process optimizations, and supplier changes through the appropriate change control and regulatory pathways.
• The Associate Director represents the function in cross-functional program teams, design reviews, and regulatory interactions, providing expert input on device reliability to Health Authority submissions (e.g., NDA/BLA device sections).
• The Associate Director supports regulatory audits and inspections and maintains a deep understanding of the evolving combination product regulatory landscape.
• Monitor and provide input into product complaint process to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Provide key insights and lessons learned to educate new product development leads on best practices.
• Utilize technical project management skills, including resource planning, work planning, risk management, prioritization, conflict management, change management, issue resolution, and progress reporting.
• Responsible for identifying and implementing requirements for safety, quality, and reliability are effectively met for CSL commercialized combination products. Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor’s in engineering (mechanical or chemical preferred)
• Minimum 10 years of experience in either parenteral or device manufacturing in the pharmaceutical space
• Leadership experience in team management or supervision
• Experience with manufacturing processes, validation practices, and cGMP guidelines
• Knowledge of process automation and equipment reliability
• Ability to collaborate with internal teams, CMs, and contractors About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. Job Description: The Director of Secondary Packaging is a leadership role within CSL’s Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP) department. In this position, you will have the opportunity to shape how medicines are delivered to CSL’s patients, advance global sustainability objectives, and drive category transformation by developing long-term strategies. This includes overseeing the transition from conventional materials and processes to innovative, patient-focused, and environmentally sustainable solutions. In this role, you will influence and drive complex global category strategies across CSL’s product portfolio working with manufacturing, supply chain, technical operations (including primary packaging, device, and human factors areas within DDSP), quality, commercial, regulatory, and procurement. You will act as a thought leader in technology, sustainability, and supplier innovation, steering CSL packaging strategy toward future‑ready solutions. Responsibilities
• Evolve secondary packaging development processes – you will champion new processes, the adoption of new tools, data driven decision making, and advanced technologies across the packaging value chain. This will also include integration into combination product development processes.
• Develop secondary packaging designs and capabilities to ensure that CSL products meet market, regulatory compliance, quality, and manufacturing requirements. Assess secondary packaging failures to determine root causes and corrective actions.
• Deliver meaningful sustainability impact – you will shape initiatives that will ensure we meet global environmental commitments.
• Contribute to a high-performing global supplier network – partner with supply chain and procurement on: supplier partnerships to drive innovation pipelines and ensure resilience and quality of our global packaging supply base.
• Professional knowledge to coach and mentor direct reports and to provide career development for team members.
• Responsible for creating workforce plans, succession plans, and staffing plans for to ensure available talent is maximized to achieve business results for CSL. Qualifications
• Packaging or other Engineering degree.
• At least 10 years of related experience in secondary packaging within the medical device and or pharmaceutical industry.
• Expertise in serialization and other anticounterfeit measures
• Experience with ISTA and ASTM for packaging and simulated shipping.
• Proven ability to develop strategies and lead improvement projects.
• Excellent communication skills and a track record working in a matrix environment; Influencing/building/promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
• Strong leadership through a partnership and engagement approach with manufacturing for advancing quality outcomes and operational excellence. About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ . Our Benefits For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL . You Belong at CSL At CSL, I

Questa posizione garantisce approcci analitici robusti, conformi e innovativi attraverso programmi clinici preclinici e LCM.

Responsabilità e responsabilità

Leadership strategica:

• Sviluppare e guidare la strategia analitica globale allineata a programmi e obiettivi aziendali

• Fornire indicazioni scientifiche e regolamentari per piani analitici in tutte le fasi di sviluppo (scoperta → post-marketing)

• Guidare l'innovazione in tecnologie analitiche, piattaforme e flussi di lavoro

• Rappresentare la funzione analitica nella governance interfunzionale e nei forum decisionali

Supervisione scientifica:

• supervisionare lo sviluppo, la convalida e l'attuazione di metodi analitici (ad esempio, LC-MS/MS, analisi leganti di legante di legante, biomarcatori, immunogenicità)

• Assicurare la generazione di dati di alta qualità per studi PK, PD, biomarcatore e immunogenicità

• Valutazione e approvazione di progetti di studio analitici, report e documentazione normativa

• Risolvere complesse sfide scientifiche e tecniche

Regolazione e conformità:

• Assicurare il rispetto delle linee guida normative globali (FDA, EMA, ICH, GLP, GCP)

• Lead sezioni analitiche delle sottomissioni normative (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA, MAA)

• Interfaccia con le agenzie di regolamentazione e rispondere alle domande dell’autorità sanitaria

• Mantenere la disponibilità di ispezione e gli standard di qualità

Collaborazione trasversale:

• Partner di Farmacologia Clinica, DMPK, Tossicologia, Biomarcatori e Operazioni Cliniche

• Sostenere le decisioni di strategia e selezione della dose

• Gestire CRO esterni, collaboratori accademici e fornitori di tecnologia

Leadership & Management:

• Leader e mentore di scienziati analitici e responsabili del progetto

• Gestione di budget, timeline e allocazione delle risorse

• Costruire e scalare le capacità analitiche e le infrastrutture

Qualifiche e requisiti di esperienza

• PhD in chimica analitica, scienze farmaceutiche, biochimica, o campo correlato (o MSc con ampia esperienza)

• Tipicamente 12-15 anni in bioanalisi all'interno di ambienti biotecnici, farmaceutici o CRO

• Profonda competenza in LC-MS/MS, analisi leganti del legante del legante, biomarcatori e test di immunogenicità

• Forte conoscenza dei requisiti normativi e degli standard di convalida analitica

• Prova leadership e esperienza strategica del programma

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Analytical Strategy Director is a senior scientific and strategic leadership role responsible for designing and overseeing analytical strategies that support drug discovery, development, and regulatory approval. This position ensures robust, compliant, and innovative analytical approaches across preclinical, clinical programs and LCM.​

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

Strategic Leadership​:

• Develop and lead the global analytical strategy aligned with program and corporate goals​

• Provide scientific and regulatory guidance for analytical plans across all development phases (discovery → post-marketing)​

• Drive innovation in analytical technologies, platforms, and workflows​

• Represent analytical function in cross-functional governance and decision-making forums​

Scientific Oversight​:

• Oversee development, validation, and implementation of analytical methods (e.g., LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, biomarkers, immunogenicity)​

• Ensure high-quality data generation for PK, PD, biomarker, and immunogenicity studies​

• Review and approve analytical study designs, reports, and regulatory documentation​

• Troubleshoot complex scientific and technical challenges​

Regulatory & Compliance​:

• Ensure compliance with global regulatory guidelines (FDA, EMA, ICH, GLP, GCP)​

• Lead analytical sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA, MAA)​

• Interface with regulatory agencies and respond to health authority queries​

• Maintain inspection readiness and quality standards​

Cross-Functional Collaboration:​

• Partner with Clinical Pharmacology, DMPK, Toxicology, Biomarkers, and Clinical Operations​

• Support translational strategy and dose selection decisions​

• Manage external CROs, academic collaborators, and technology vendors​

Leadership & Management:​

• Lead and mentor analytical scientists and project leaders​

• Manage budgets, timelines, and resource allocation​

• Build and scale analytical capabilities and infrastructure​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements​

## Descrizione

For our CSL Behring Operations / Manufacturing, we are looking for a Head of Manufacturing Engineering and Maintenance

Closing Date for Applications – 17th April 2026

The Head of Manufacturing Engineering & Maintenance is a strategic leader responsible for the reliability and lifecycle management of manufacturing assets. This role oversees Calibration & Metrology Engineering, Manufacturing Maintenance, Reliability Engineering, Production/System Owner Engineering, and Shutdown Planning & Scheduling. Key responsibilities support critical operations, including fractionation, bulk production, and packaging, while ensuring equipment readiness and compliance with regulatory standards in the biopharmaceutical sector. The position also requires strong skills in labour relations to foster collaboration within a unionized workforce.
Role that this position reports to: Engineering & Maintenance Site Head

## Job Purpose

- Direct all aspects of manufacturing engineering and maintenance, including technical support, project management, emergency response, on-call, troubleshooting and corrective, preventive/predictive maintenance
- Ensure facilities and equipment are designed, operated and maintained in compliance with cGMP, Health Authorities (i.e. FDA), EHS
- Drives execution of qualification plans, risk analysis, metrology, data integrity and general GMP issues
- Lead the planning, budgeting, execution and commissioning of major capital projects, facility expansions, and technology upgrades
- Champion asset lifecycle management, reliability engineering and implementation
- Oversees sites workshop operations
- Develop, communicate and execute an engineering and maintenance strategy
- Lead transformation initiatives, including digitalization, advanced automation, sustainability and adoption of cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
- Supports the development and implementation of multi-year strategic plans, capital investment roadmaps and operational readiness programs for all global site
- Lead the sites manufacturing engineering and maintenance organization
- Oversee deviation management, investigation of deviations and establishment of corrective and preventive actions plus develop, monitor and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for engineering and maintenance
- Represent the local manufacturing engineering and maintenance function in regulatory inspections, audit readiness
- Champion the use of digital tools and data analytics (e.g., SAP, Trackwise, FMS, Ariba, Power BI, Smart Sheet, Tableau) and implement CSL Operating System, Six Sigma, Lean
- Conducts regular GEMBAS
- Oversee the management of GMP/non-GMP facility systems
- Manage relationships with external service providers, contractors and vendors
- Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain, IT and other departments
- Engage with global and regional leadership
- Lead, mentor and develop a diverse, cross-functional team
- Oversees assigned cost centres, monitors performances and acts on trends
- Develops budgets for OpEx and headcounts

## Your Skills and Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical) required, a master’s preferred
- Minimum of ten years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, food, or chemical process industry
- At least five years of technical management or leadership experience
- Significant expertise in GMP/non-GMP manufacturing assets related to pharmaceutical production
- Expertise in sterile manufacturing, bulk production and finishing and packaging operations of (bio) pharmaceuticals
- Experience managing union and non-union workforces
- Advanced skills in facility management systems (Trackwise, SAP, FMS, Ariba, DCMS) and digital tools (MS Project, Excel, Power BI, Smart Sheet, Tableau)
- Knowledge of Six Sigma/Lean principles
- Financial acumen in managing multimillion-dollar budgets
- Experience with global health authorities’ inspections, audits and regulatory agencies

Descrizione
• Stiamo cercando un Regional Regulatory Lead (RRL) strategico e collaborativo da inserire nel nostro team Global Regulatory Affairs. In questo ruolo, guiderai attività normative sia strategiche che operative all'interno di un'area terapeutica (TA) assegnata nelle regioni APAC, LATAM e delle aziende partner. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con le parti interessate globali e regionali per garantire approvazioni normative tempestive e una gestione efficace del ciclo di vita per i prodotti designati. Collaborando con il responsabile dell'area terapeutica e con il responsabile della regolamentazione globale, contribuirai alle strategie normative globali adattando ed eseguendo strategie regionali in linea con le priorità aziendali e commerciali. Questa è un’entusiasmante opportunità per svolgere un ruolo chiave nel portare terapie critiche ai pazienti nei mercati internazionali dinamici e in rapida crescita. Responsabilità chiave: agire come responsabile della regolamentazione regionale per i prodotti e i paesi assegnati, garantendo l'allineamento con la strategia e le priorità normative globali. - Sviluppare e implementare strategie normative regionali che supportino le registrazioni dei prodotti, la gestione del ciclo di vita e gli obiettivi aziendali. - Identificare percorsi efficienti di approvazione normativa in collaborazione con i rappresentanti locali delle autorità di regolamentazione (LRR) e i rappresentanti dei partner normativi (RPR). - Contribuire alle attività del Global Regulatory Affairs Strategy Team (GRAST) e supportare lo sviluppo di strategie normative globali. - Guidare e supervisionare le attività normative in tutto il portafoglio assegnato, identificando e gestendo in modo proattivo i rischi normativi. - Garantire comunicazioni normative e risposte di alta qualità alle domande dell'Autorità sanitaria in linea con i requisiti e le tempistiche regionali. - Collaborare strettamente con le parti interessate interne, gli LRR e gli RPR per supportare approvazioni tempestive e conformità normativa. - Costruire e mantenere forti rapporti con le autorità sanitarie regionali attraverso una comunicazione efficace e una documentazione di alta qualità. - Rimani informato sulla legislazione normativa internazionale, sulle linee guida e sugli sviluppi del settore rilevanti per i prodotti e le attività CSL. - Valutare l'impatto dell'evoluzione delle normative locali e regionali e fornire valutazioni del rischio normativo. - Supportare iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare i processi normativi, la conformità e l'eccellenza operativa. Qualifiche ed esperienza Istruzione: laurea in scienze biologiche, scienze mediche, farmacia o un campo correlato. - Le qualifiche post-laurea o la specializzazione in Drug Regulatory Affairs sono considerate un vantaggio. Esperienza - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in materia normativa nei mercati internazionali. - È altamente auspicabile ulteriore esperienza nel settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico. Capacità e competenze: è richiesto un inglese fluente. - Ulteriori lingue sono considerate una risorsa (ad esempio arabo, francese, spagnolo, russo). - Ottima conoscenza dello sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici e dei requisiti normativi. - Conoscenza dei principi GMP e GCP. - Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, gestione degli stakeholder e organizzative. - Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente globale e interfunzionale. Perché unirsi a noi? Si tratta di un'opportunità unica per contribuire alla fornitura di terapie che cambiano la vita ai pazienti di tutto il mondo, lavorando in un ambiente globale collaborativo e innovativo. Noi di CSL siamo impegnati nel miglioramento continuo, nell’eccellenza scientifica e nel fare una differenza significativa nella vita dei pazienti. Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale nel campo della bioterapia guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite umane. Concentrati nel soddisfare le esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le tecnologie più recenti, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con patologie nelle aree terapeutiche immunologica, ematologica, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e dei trapianti. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ​​ricombinanti e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a strategic and collaborative Regional Regulatory Lead (RRL) to join our Global Regulatory Affairs team. In this role, you will lead both strategic and operational regulatory activities within an assigned Therapeutic Area (TA) across APAC, LATAM, and Partner Business Regions. You will work closely with global and regional stakeholders to ensure timely regulatory approvals and successful lifecycle management for designated products. Partnering with the Therapeutic Area Lead and the Global Regulatory Lead, you will contribute to global regulatory strategies while adapting and executing regional strategies aligned with business and commercial priorities. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in bringing critical therapies to patients across dynamic and fast-growing international markets. Key Responsibilities
• Act as the regional regulatory lead for assigned products and countries, ensuring alignment with global regulatory strategy and priorities.
• Develop and implement regional regulatory strategies that support product registrations, lifecycle management, and business objectives.
• Identify efficient regulatory approval pathways in collaboration with Local Regulatory Representatives (LRRs) and Regulatory Partner Representatives (RPRs).
• Contribute to Global Regulatory Affairs Strategy Team (GRAST) activities and support the development of global regulatory strategies.
• Lead and oversee regulatory activities across the assigned portfolio, proactively identifying and managing regulatory risks.
• Ensure high-quality regulatory submissions and responses to Health Authority questions in line with regional requirements and timelines.
• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, LRRs, and RPRs to support timely approvals and regulatory compliance.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with regional Health Authorities through effective communication and high-quality documentation.
• Stay informed on international regulatory legislation, guidelines, and industry developments relevant to CSL products and activities.
• Assess the impact of evolving local and regional regulations and provide regulatory risk assessments.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance regulatory processes, compliance, and operational excellence. Qualifications & Experience Education
• Degree in Biological Sciences, Medical Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related field.
• Postgraduate qualifications or specialization in Drug Regulatory Affairs are considered an advantage. Experience
• Minimum 5 years of regulatory affairs experience within international markets.
• Additional pharmaceutical or biotech industry experience is highly desirable. Skills & Competencies
• Fluent English is required.
• Additional languages are considered an asset (e.g., Arabic, French, Spanish, Russian).
• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical product development and regulatory requirements.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a global and cross-functional environment. Why Join Us? Description Nous recherchons un responsable de la réglementation régionale (RRL) stratégique et collaboratif pour rejoindre notre équipe des affaires réglementaires mondiales. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez les activités réglementaires stratégiques et opérationnelles au sein d'un domaine thérapeutique (TA) attribué dans les régions APAC, LATAM et partenaires. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes mondiales et régionales pour garantir les approbations réglementaires en temps opportun et une gestion réussie du cycle de vie des produits désignés. En partenariat avec le responsable du domaine thérapeutique et le responsable de la réglementation mondiale, vous contribuerez aux stratégies réglementaires mondiales tout en adaptant et en exécutant des stratégies régionales alignées sur les priorités commerciales. Il s’agit d’une opportunité passionnante de jouer un rôle clé en apportant des thérapies essentielles aux patients sur des marchés internationaux dynamiques et en croissance rapide. Principales responsabilités - Agir en tant que responsable régional de la réglementation pour les produits et les pays assignés, en assurant l'alignement avec la stratégie et les priorités réglementaires mondiales. - Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies réglementaires régionales qui soutiennent les enregistrements de produits, la gestion du cycle de vie et les objectifs commerciaux. - Identifier les voies d'approbation réglementaires efficaces en collaboration avec les représentants réglementaires locaux (LRR) et les représentants des partenaires réglementaires (RPR). - Contribuer aux activités de l'équipe de stratégie des affaires réglementaires mondiales (GRAST) et soutenir le développement de stratégies réglementaires mondiales. - Diriger et superviser les activités réglementaires dans l'ensemble du portefeuille assigné, en identifiant et en gérant de manière proactive les risques réglementaires. - Assurer des soumissions réglementaires de haute qualité et des réponses aux questions des autorités sanitaires conformément aux exigences et aux délais régionaux. - Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes internes, les LRR et les RPR pour soutenir les approbations en temps opportun et la conformité réglementaire. - Établir et entretenir des relations solides avec les autorités sanitaires régionales grâce à une communication efficace et une documentation de haute qualité. - Restez informé de la législation réglementaire internationale, des lignes directrices et des développements de l'industrie pertinents pour les produits et activités de CSL. - Évaluer l'impact de l'évolution des réglementations locales et régionales et fournir des évaluations des risques réglementaires. - Soutenir les initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus réglementaires, la conformité et l'excellence opérationnelle.
• Qualifications et expérience Éducation - Diplôme en sciences biologiques, en sciences médicales, en pharmacie ou dans un domaine connexe. - Des diplômes de troisième cycle ou une spécialisation en affaires réglementaires pharmaceutiques sont considérés comme un avantage. Expérience - Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en affaires réglementaires sur les marchés internationaux. - Une expérience supplémentaire dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique est hautement souhaitable. Aptitudes et compétences - Un anglais courant est requis. - Des langues supplémentaires sont considérées comme un atout (par exemple, arabe, français, espagnol, russe). - Forte compréhension du développement de produits pharmaceutiques et des exigences réglementaires. - Connaissance des principes GMP et GCP. - Excellentes compétences en communication, en gestion des parties prenantes et en organisation. - Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement global et interfonctionnel. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Il s’agit d’une opportunité unique de contribuer à la fourniture de thérapies qui changent la vie des patients du monde entier, tout en travaillant dans un environnement mondial collaboratif et innovant. Chez CSL, nous nous engageons à l’amélioration continue, à l’excellence scientifique et à faire une différence significative dans la vie des patients. À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un leader mondial des biothérapeutiques animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Axés sur la satisfaction des besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et proposons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant avec des maladies dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l’immunologie, de l’hématologie, des maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et de transplantation. Nous utilisons trois plates-formes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement du plasma, de technologie des protéines recombinantes et de thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue.

Descrizione Il programmatore statistico principale è responsabile di fornire leadership e supporto pratico nello sviluppo e nella manutenzione delle capacità di programmazione statistica CSL che è tenuto a soddisfare gli obblighi normativi. L'individuo lavorerà a stretto contatto con il direttore associato, direttore e programmatori statistici per costruire strumenti di programmazione interni. Questo individuo, lavorando a stretto contatto con il team di studio, sarà responsabile per la revisione e l'accettazione delle organizzazioni di ricerca contrattuale (CRO) che sono principalmente, ma non solo, datasets in presentazione formato standard pronto (ADaM), tabelle, figure, elenchi e pacchetti di presentazione. Questo individuo fornirà competenze nel processo di progettazione, sviluppo e controllo della qualità per i programmi SAS utilizzati per accedere, estrarre, trasformare, rivedere, analizzare e inviare dati clinici per tutte le analisi richieste. Questo individuo collaborerà con altri dipartimenti (ad esempio, Biostatistica, Gestione dei dati, Operazioni regolamentari, Scrittura Medica, ESP team) per garantire che vengano seguite procedure operative standard e i dati di studio corretti vengono utilizzati per tutte le richieste. Questo individuo parteciperà a iniziative di sviluppo tecnologico funzionale e di miglioramento dei processi. Mansioni - Collabora con i team di studio per progettare la struttura e le specifiche dei dati per gli erogabili ad hoc e di studio, inclusi, ma non limitati ai dataset ADaM, Tabelle, Figure, Liste e Analisi contenuti della sottomissione. Piani e conduce gli sforzi di produzione e validazione per la produzione progettata, questo può includere la supervisione del lavoro da parte dei CRO. - Collabora con i team di studio per garantire la qualità e l'accuratezza – quindi la disponibilità di presentazione – dei dati clinici richiesti dalle autorità (ad esempio SDTM, ADaM, tabelle, figure, elenchi, Defini.xml). Supporta la revisione dei relativi consegnabili quando forniti da CROs. - Piombo e supervisione hanno richiesto sforzi per analisi in pool ed esplorative che lavorano a stretto contatto con Statistiche TA lead e/o studi statistici, nonché con il team di programmazione clinica e la loro raccolta di dati legacy. - conduce e supervisiona le specifiche interne e la consegna dei set di dati ISS e ISE e l'output associato (tavoli, cifre e elenchi) quando non è fornito da CRO. - conduce e supervisiona la progettazione e l'implementazione di programmi SAS complessi per applicazioni progettate per analizzare e riportare i dati di prova clinici complessi in formato CDISC ADaM. - conduce e supervisiona lo sviluppo di strumenti globali che aumenteranno l'efficienza e la capacità del gruppo di programmazione statistica. - Lavora a stretto contatto con i team di studio clinici per eseguire attività per garantire che le tempistiche del progetto siano soddisfatte con materiali di alta qualità. Attività supplemento - Collabora con il personale CR&D per quanto riguarda le richieste di analisi dei dati. - Esegui analisi statistiche aggiuntive, comprese ma non limitate a: - risposte di supporto alle agenzie di regolamentazione, - generare sintesi integrata della sicurezza e dell'efficacia, - pubblicazioni di supporto e presentazioni, - pianificazione di supporto e reporting di studi clinici tramite analisi esplorative dei dati disponibili, - replicare analisi statistiche CRO e CSL per QC
• Requisiti Istruzione - BSc in Informatica, Matematica, Statistica o area relativa con esperienza rilevante - Altri gradi Almeno 7 anni di esperienza nella programmazione clinica e/o nella programmazione statistica, all'interno dell'ambiente CRO/farmaceutico utilizzando il software SAS. - No. Comprensione approfondita dei processi e degli standard di programmazione clinica e/o di programmazione statistica. - comprensione approfondita dei requisiti normativi relativi alla programmazione statistica (ad esempio GCP, ICH). - Ampia esperienza con la programmazione statistica utilizzando il software SAS compreso lo sviluppo e l'uso di SAS Macros. Forte capacità di programmazione e risoluzione dei problemi. - Avanzato kn
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Principal Statistical Programmer is responsible for providing leadership and hands-on support in the development and maintenance of the CSL statistical programming capabilities which is required to meet regulatory obligations. The individual will work closely with the Associate Director, Director, and Statistical Programmers to build internal programming tools. This individual, working closely with the study team, will be responsible for review and acceptance of contract research organization (CRO) deliverables which are mainly, but not limited to, datasets in submission ready standard format (ADaM), tables, figures, listings and submission packages. This individual will provide expertise in the design, development and quality control process for SAS programs used to access, extract, transform, review, analyze and submit clinical data for all requested analyses. This individual will collaborate with other departments (eg, Biostatistics, Data Management, Regulatory Operations, Medical Writing, ESP teams) to ensure Standard Operating Procedures are followed and the correct study data are used for all requests. This individual will participate in department and cross functional technology development and process improvement initiatives. Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
• Collaborates with the study teams to design data structure and specifications for ad hoc and study deliverables including, but not limited to ADaM datasets, Tables, Figures, Listings and Analysis Submission content. Plans and leads the production and validation efforts for the designed output, this may include oversight of work by CROs.
• Collaborates with study teams to ensure the quality and accuracy – thus submission readiness – of clinical data as required by authorities (i.e. SDTM, ADaM, tables, figures, listings, define.xml). Supports the review of related deliverables when provided by CROs.
• Leads and oversees requested efforts for pooled and exploratory analyses working closely with Statistics TA lead and/or study statisticians as well as with clinical programming team and their collection of legacy data.
• Leads and oversees the in-house specification and delivery of ISS and ISE datasets and associated output (tables, figures and listings) when not provided by CRO.
• Leads and oversees the design and implementation of complex SAS programs for applications designed to analyze and report complex clinical trial data in CDISC ADaM format.
• Leads and oversees the development of global tools that will increase the efficiency and capacity of the Statistical Programming group.
• Works closely with clinical study teams to execute activities to ensure project timelines are met with high quality deliverables. Additional tasks: Collaborates with CR&D staff regarding data analysis requests. Performs additional statistical analyses including but not limited to:
• support responses to regulatory agencies,
• generate integrated summary of safety and efficacy,
• support publications and presentations,
• support planning and reporting of clinical trials via exploratory analyses of available data,
• replicate CRO and CSL statistician analyses for QC Job Qualifications and Experience Requirements: Education
• BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related area with relevant experience
• Other degrees and certifications considered if commensurate with related programming experience Experience
• At least 7 years of experience in either clinical programming and/or statistical programming, within the CRO/pharmaceutical environment using SAS Software.
• In-depth understanding of clinical programming and/or statistical programming processes and standards.
• In-depth understanding of regulatory requirements relevant to statistical programming (e.g. GCP, ICH).
• Extensive experience with statistical programming using the SAS software including development and use of SAS Macros. Strong programming and problem-solving skills.
• Advanced kn
